papers.title: SPT-3G D1: Foreground-Robust Lensing Templates for Primordial Gravitational Wave Searches
papers.abstract: Gravitational lensing of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) generates B-mode polarization that acts as a source of contamination to searches for B modes generated by primordial gravitational waves (PGWs). The strongest constraint on PGW B modes is already significantly limited by lensing B modes, as shown in the most recent BICEP result. In this work, we present CMB lensing B-mode templates constructed using SPT-3G and Planck data, which characterize the lensing B modes and can be used to improve PGW B-mode searches. We use SPT-3G data from the 2019 and 2020 observing seasons for the E modes and the CMB-reconstructed lensing potential, and a cosmic infrared background (CIB) map from Planck as an external lensing tracer. To test for extragalactic foreground biases in the lensing template, we consider CMB lensing reconstruction variants with different levels of foreground immunity: the standard and profile-hardened global minimum variance (GMV) quadratic estimators, and a polarization-only quadratic estimator. We validate the template construction using Gaussian simulations and Agora simulations with realistic non-Gaussian foregrounds. From simulations, we find that foreground-induced biases are strongly suppressed for the template constructed with the profile-hardened GMV + CIB tracer, with residual bias below 10% of the statistical uncertainty on the template power spectrum. Data difference tests on this template similarly show no evidence for significant foreground contamination. This foreground-immune lensing template achieves delensed residual BB power of $A_{\rm lens}^{\rm res} \simeq 0.48$ averaged over $20 \leq \ell \leq 200$, the highest delensing efficiency lensing template to date. These results demonstrate and validate a method to construct foreground-robust lensing templates which will be used in upcoming delensed PGW B-mode analyses of BICEP data.

analysis.title_zh: SPT-3G D1：用于原初引力波搜索的前景稳健透镜模板
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 CMB 透镜产生的 B 模对原初引力波 B 模搜索的污染，使用 SPT-3G 与 Planck 数据构建透镜 B 模模板，并用不同前景免疫程度的透镜重构方案和模拟检验前景偏差。摘要报告，profile-hardened GMV + CIB 示踪模板的前景诱导偏差被强烈抑制，数据差分检验未见显著前景污染，且在 20≤ℓ≤200 上达到 A_lens^res≈0.48 的残余透镜 B 模功率。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 透镜 B 模已经成为限制原初引力波 B 模探测的重要系统项；一个经过前景稳健性验证的高效率去透镜模板，直接关系到 BICEP、SPT-3G 等实验对张量标量比的约束能力。
key_points: 构建面向原初引力波 B 模搜索的 CMB 透镜 B 模模板。
比较标准 GMV、profile-hardened GMV 和仅偏振二次估计量以检验前景偏差。
摘要称 profile-hardened GMV + CIB 示踪模板前景残余偏差较低，并达到很高的去透镜效率。
methods: SPT-3G 2019 和 2020 观测季数据
Planck 宇宙红外背景 CIB 图作为外部透镜示踪量
CMB 透镜重构
标准与 profile-hardened 全局最小方差 GMV 二次估计量
仅偏振二次估计量
Gaussian simulations
Agora realistic non-Gaussian foreground simulations
数据差分检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对的是 profile-hardening 与 CIB 联合模板如何处理外星系前景、模板功率谱残余偏差的定义，以及该模板用于 BICEP 去透镜分析时是否存在与目标 B 模图的相关性或选择偏差。

papers.title: The plunging region of thin accretion discs across the black hole spin range
papers.abstract: We compute and test analytic models for the plunging region dynamics, thermodynamics, and magnetic fields against dedicated 3D global general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) simulations of thin accretion discs around black holes across the spin range, using the code {\tt ATHENAK}. We find that the dynamics of the plunging fluid closely resembles that of a gravity-dominated geodesic plunge, with the best agreement at low spins. Additionally, we find good agreement between the thermodynamic framework and the simulated quantities across the spin range. Finally, we develop a new model for the magnetic fields in the plunging region that assumes a fixed geodesic inflow, into which the magnetic fields are frozen. Overall, our simulations are in good concordance with this model, albeit with some discrepancies that suggest a degree of non-ideal MHD dissipation. In addition, we investigate how the MHD stresses in the plunging region depend on the black hole spin, interpreting our results through the lens of our flux-freezing model. We find that the magnitude of the stress increases as the black hole spin is increased in the prograde direction. This question is of particular importance for observers who wish to determine the black hole spin from X-ray measurements of the inner accretion disc, since a low-stress, high-spin solution is degenerate with a high-stress, low-spin solution. The spin-stress relationship that we report is approximately orthogonal to the contour of degenerate spin-stress pairings, indicating that the degeneracy is not fundamental. We show this explicitly for the case of M33 X-7.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, submitted to MNRAS, comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 跨黑洞自旋范围的薄吸积盘下落区
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究薄吸积盘在黑洞内区 plunging region 的动力学、热力学与磁场行为，并用 ATHENAK 进行的跨自旋 3D 全局 GRMHD 模拟检验解析模型。摘要称下落流体总体接近重力主导的测地线下落，热力学框架与模拟吻合较好，新磁通冻结模型也大体符合模拟，同时提示存在一定非理想 MHD 耗散，并发现顺行自旋越高 MHD 应力越强。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于高能天体物理而非 CMB 研究；其宇宙学关联在于黑洞自旋和吸积盘内区辐射建模会影响高能源族群的物理解释，但与 CMB 各向异性、前景建模或参数推断没有直接关系。
key_points: 研究薄吸积盘在黑洞内稳圆轨道内侧的 plunging region。
用跨自旋范围的 3D GRMHD 模拟检验解析动力学、热力学和磁场模型。
摘要报告顺行自旋越高，plunging region 的 MHD 应力幅度越大。
methods: 解析模型
3D 全局广义相对论磁流体力学模拟
ATHENAK 代码

测地线下落模型

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟的薄盘厚度、磁场初始条件和自旋采样如何影响应力-自旋关系，以及将该关系用于 X 射线自旋测量时的模型依赖性。

papers.title: An "inside-out" approach to modeling supermassive black hole binary inspiral
papers.abstract: The inspiral and merger of two supermassive black holes (SMBHs) releases immense energy in low-frequency gravitational waves (GWs). Recent pulsar timing array (PTA) observations of the stochastic nHz GW background (GWB) are consistent with a SMBH binary origin. GW data from PTAs and from the upcoming Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) can probe late-stage binary evolution where electromagnetic constraints are scarce. However, the complexity of the relevant astrophysics necessitates a well optimized approach. I argue that a key physical quantity to constrain with PTAs is the orbital semi-major axis at which binary inspiral transitions from the astrophysical to the GW-dominated regime ($a_{\rm GW}$). This quantity should be treated as a free parameter in analysis of the GWB. Using this premise, I present a simple analytic framework for modeling SMBH binary inspiral in an "inside-out" fashion. At orbital separations slightly larger than $a_{\rm GW}$, a power-law scaling for the astrophysical inspiral timescale is assumed, while the outermost phase (prior to the PTA regime) is simply modeled via a delay time. I show that the GWB spectral shape and amplitude are most sensitive to $a_{\rm GW}$ (normalized to $10^9 M_{\odot}$, equal-mass binaries and expressed in gravitational units), with weaker dependence on the inner power-law index and the outer delay time. The GWB is largely insensitive to the mass and mass-ratio scaling of $a_{\rm GW}$ and to the boundary between the inner and outer astrophysical inspiral regimes. I compare with models for gas- and stellar-driven binary inspiral and discuss implications for LISA and for GW source parameter inference.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 12 figures, submitted to ApJ. Comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 一种用于超大质量双黑洞内旋建模的“由内向外”方法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对超大质量双黑洞并合前的复杂天体物理演化，提出一种“inside-out”解析建模方法，把进入引力波主导内旋的轨道半长轴 a_GW 作为 PTA 随机引力波背景分析中的关键自由参数。摘要报告 GWB 的谱形和振幅最敏感于 a_GW，而对内区幂律指数、外层延迟时间以及若干标度假设的依赖较弱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文与 CMB 的联系是宇宙学背景信号和参数推断层面的：PTA 探测的纳赫兹随机引力波背景是另一类宇宙学/天体物理背景场，其源模型会影响对黑洞并合史和星系演化的解释；但它不直接处理 CMB 温度、偏振或透镜数据。
key_points: 提出从小尺度向外建模 SMBH 双黑洞内旋的 inside-out 框架。
主张将从天体物理驱动转入引力波主导的半长轴 a_GW 作为 PTA 随机背景分析的自由参数。
摘要称 GWB 谱形和振幅对 a_GW 最敏感，对若干外层演化假设较不敏感。
methods: 解析建模框架
PTA 纳赫兹随机引力波背景建模
a_GW 自由参数化
天体物理内旋时标的幂律标度
外层延迟时间模型
与气体驱动和恒星驱动内旋模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 a_GW 参数化与 SMBH 质量、质量比、红移分布之间的退化关系，以及该简化框架在 PTA 数据和未来 LISA 推断中是否足够灵活。

papers.title: Reanalyzing Megamasers: a low value of $H_0$ from a local probe changes our view of the Hubble Tension
papers.abstract: Megamaser distances can be measured without using the traditional distance ladder. As such, they provide an independent probe of the local expansion rate, quantified by the Hubble constant $H_0$. We re-analyze megamaser distance and redshift data to obtain a new, more accurate, estimate of $H_0$. The main improvement in our analysis is the use of a new velocity field reconstruction to correct redshifts for peculiar velocities. This reconstruction utilizes constrained cosmological simulations in addition to redshift survey data to more accurately capture both coherent flows as well as nonGaussian individual galaxy motions. We argue that previous estimates of $H_0$ from megamaser data were susceptible to bias due to peculiar velocities. By correcting for peculiar motions using this new reconstruction we obtain a value of $H_0$ that is consistent with the value from the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) and in tension with the value from the local distance ladder at greater than a $2σ$ level, whereas previous results showed consistency with the distance ladder and tension with the CMB at greater than $2σ$. Our results suggest that the Hubble tension is due to some heretofore undetermined systematic in the distance ladder rather than new physics.

analysis.title_zh: 重新分析兆脉泽：来自本地探针的低 H0 值改变了我们对哈勃张力的看法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新分析 megamaser 距离和红移数据，以获得独立于传统距离阶梯的本地 H0 估计，主要改进是使用结合受约束宇宙学模拟和红移巡天数据的新速度场重建来修正本动速度。摘要称新结果与 CMB 推断的 H0 一致，并与本地距离阶梯结果存在超过 2σ 的张力，从而将解释指向距离阶梯中的未知系统误差而非新物理。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇与 CMB 宇宙学高度相关，因为它直接比较本地、非距离阶梯的 H0 测量与 CMB 推断值，并改变了 megamaser 在哈勃张力讨论中的方向。若摘要结论稳健，它会削弱“CMB 与本地宇宙之间需要新物理”的解释压力，并把重点转向本动速度校正和距离阶梯系统误差。
key_points: 重新分析不依赖传统距离阶梯的 megamaser 距离和红移数据。
关键改进是用新的速度场重建修正本动速度。
摘要称得到的 H0 与 CMB 值一致，并与本地距离阶梯值存在超过 2σ 的张力。
methods: megamaser 距离和红移数据再分析
新的速度场重建
受约束宇宙学模拟
红移巡天数据
本动速度修正
与 CMB 和本地距离阶梯 H0 比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对速度场重建和本动速度误差模型是否会主导 H0 后验，包括受约束模拟、红移巡天选择函数、非高斯个体星系运动处理，以及与既有 megamaser 分析的差异是否足以支撑系统误差解释。

papers.title: A Neutron Star Hidden Inside a Black Hole
papers.abstract: We investigate dark matter admixed neutron stars in which the neutron star coexists with an anisotropic dark matter halo described by the Einasto density profile, a model recently shown to produce regular, singularity-free black hole solutions~[Phys. Rev. D \textbf{113}, 043011 (2026)]. Solving the modified Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equations with two different equations of state (BSk19 and SLy4), we find that the dark matter halo significantly alters the neutron star structure. Furthermore, for a specific range of halo parameters, $g_{rr}^{-1}$ changes sign outside the stellar surface, forming an event horizon with the neutron star persisting as a regular configuration inside it--- ``neutron stars in black holes''. This configuration appears in both equations of state and does not depend on a specific choice of the equation of state. The discovery of this configuration provides a new perspective and a concrete computable instance for the study of what lies inside a black hole.

analysis.title_zh: 隐藏在黑洞内部的一颗中子星
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一种由 Einasto 密度轮廓描述的各向异性暗物质晕与中子星共存的模型，并用两种核物质状态方程求解修正 TOV 方程。摘要报告，在特定暗物质晕参数范围内，星体表面外可出现事件视界，而中子星仍作为正则构型存在于其中，且该现象在 BSk19 和 SLy4 两种状态方程中都出现。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于强引力、致密星和暗物质模型研究，与 CMB 的联系较间接。对 CMB 宇宙学读者而言，其相关性在于暗物质可能具有非标准致密结构或强引力表现，但摘要没有给出与宇宙学暗物质丰度、CMB 各向异性或大尺度结构约束的直接连接，因此更适合作为暗物质天体物理和广义相对论背景材料。
key_points: 研究含暗物质晕的中子星解，并讨论事件视界可在星体表面外形成的情形。
暗物质晕采用 Einasto 密度轮廓，并求解修正 TOV 方程。
摘要称该构型在 BSk19 与 SLy4 两种状态方程下都出现。

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暗物质晕应力-能量张量和各向异性压力的物理可行性、能量条件与稳定性分析是否充分；还需检查用 g_rr^{-1} 变号识别事件视界的坐标与全局因果结构论证，以及这种“黑洞内中子星”构型是否有可观测区分度。

papers.title: Spinning Particle Dynamics and Observational Redshift around an Asymptotically Flat Symmergent Black Hole
papers.abstract: We investigate timelike particle dynamics, collision energetics, and photon frequency shifts in the perturbative variable-scalar curvature branch of asymptotically flat symmergent gravity. The low-energy vacuum action contains an $R^{2}$ correction whose coefficient is set by the boson--fermion imbalance of the underlying quantum field theory. At linear order, the exterior geometry is conformal to Schwarzschild spacetime through a radial mode satisfying a linear equation. We retain an independent boundary-condition-dependent amplitude and restrict the analysis to the perturbative domain. The two signs of the symmergent parameter $γ$ yield distinct profiles: $γ>0$ gives a Yukawa-suppressed deformation, whereas $γ<0$ produces an oscillatory inverse-radius deformation. We derive radial equations, effective potentials, circular-orbit and marginal-stability conditions for neutral, electrically charged, and spinning massive particles. Charged particles are treated in the test-field approximation, while spinning particles obey the Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon equations with the Tulczyjew condition. We also compute the center-of-mass energy of neutral-particle collisions and the frequency shifts of photons emitted tangentially by circular geodesic sources and detected by a static observer at infinity. The redshift and blueshift factors satisfy $(1+z_{+})(1+z_{-})=1/A(r_e)$, directly linking their product to the lapse function at emission. The $γ>0$ branch yields smooth, short-range deviations from Schwarzschild dynamics, whereas the $γ<0$ branch can generate oscillatory radial bands admitting circular-orbit solutions whose stability must be tested independently. These observables provide complementary probes of the variable-curvature sector, although their quantitative interpretation also depends on the deformation amplitude and, for the oscillatory branch, its phase.

analysis.title_zh: 渐近平坦 Symmergent 黑洞周围的自旋粒子动力学与观测红移
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究渐近平坦 symmergent 引力中可变标量曲率分支的黑洞外部，推导中性、带电和自旋 massive 粒子的径向运动、有效势、圆轨道与稳定条件，并计算粒子碰撞能量及圆轨道源的光子频移。摘要称 γ>0 分支表现为平滑短程的 Schwarzschild 偏离，γ<0 分支可出现振荡径向带并允许需另行检验稳定性的圆轨道解。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于强引力和黑洞可观测量研究，与 CMB 的直接联系较弱；其宇宙学相关性在于检验修改引力模型的低能有效几何，而这类模型若用于早期宇宙或大尺度背景，也需与 CMB 对引力和膨胀史的约束相容。
key_points: 研究渐近平坦 symmergent 黑洞外部几何中的类时粒子、带电粒子和自旋粒子动力学。
摘要报告 γ>0 分支给出 Yukawa 抑制的短程偏离，γ<0 分支给出振荡型径向形变。
光子红移/蓝移乘积与发射处 lapse 函数直接相关，但定量解释依赖形变振幅和振荡相位。
methods: 线性阶、与 Schwarzschild 时空共形的外部几何
径向方程、有效势、圆轨道和边际稳定条件推导
带电粒子的测试场近似
Mathisson--Papapetrou--Dixon 方程与 Tulczyjew 条件

papers.title: A Novel Kerr-like Black Hole in a General Double Power Law Dark Matter Environment: Geometry, Spectroscopy, and Energy Extraction
papers.abstract: We construct a novel Kerr-like black hole solution embedded in a general double power law dark matter environment by applying the Newman--Janis algorithm to a Schwarzschild-like seed geometry. This framework provides a unified rotating spacetime for arbitrary double power law density profiles and reveals how dark matter modifies the horizon structure, extremal spin, and curvature properties of rotating black holes. Remarkably, we find that the rotation--halo interplay can eliminate essential curvature singularities for Dehnen-type profiles with $γ\leq2$, despite the singular nature of the corresponding static configurations. We then investigate the spectroscopic signatures of the dark matter environment through massive scalar perturbations in the Dehnen $(1,4,γ)$ halo. Using an analytical low-frequency matching method, we derive the quasibound state spectrum, the onset condition for scalar cloud formation, and superradiant amplification factor, showing that the halo parameters $ρ_0 r_0^3$ and $γ$ leave characteristic imprints on the scalar spectrum. Increasing the halo density or the cusp strengthens the binding of quasibound states and enhances their decay, shifts the scalar cloud threshold, and suppresses superradiant amplification effectivity by narrowing the allowed frequency window and lowering the amplification factor peak. Finally, we analyze rotational energy extraction from thermal scalar fields and demonstrate that the efficiency is controlled by the interplay between the thermal spectrum and the superradiant instability, with lower temperatures and less cuspy density profiles yielding more efficient energy extraction.

analysis.title_zh: 一般双幂律暗物质环境中的新型类 Kerr 黑洞：几何、光谱学与能量提取
analysis.summary_zh: 论文构造了一个嵌入一般双幂律暗物质环境的 Kerr-like 黑洞解，并研究暗物质对视界结构、极端自旋、曲率性质及标量扰动谱的影响。摘要报告称，在 Dehnen 型剖面中旋转-晕相互作用可在 γ≤2 时消除本质曲率奇点，且晕密度和尖 cusp 会改变准束缚态、标量云阈值、超辐射放大以及热标量场能量提取效率。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作主要属于强引力和暗物质晕中的黑洞物理，与 CMB 的联系较间接；其宇宙学意义在于探索暗物质密度剖面对紧致天体时空和粒子场信号的影响，可作为暗物质天体物理模型的补充背景，但不是直接的 CMB 观测或参数推断论文。
key_points: 构造了嵌入一般双幂律暗物质环境的 Kerr-like 旋转黑洞解。
摘要称 Dehnen 型剖面在 γ≤2 时，旋转与晕的相互作用可消除本质曲率奇点。
暗物质晕参数会影响标量准束缚态、标量云阈值、超辐射放大和热标量场能量提取效率。
methods: Newman--Janis 算法
Schwarzschild-like seed geometry
一般双幂律暗物质密度剖面
Dehnen (1,4,γ) halo
massive scalar perturbations
解析低频匹配方法

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 Newman--Janis 算法在含暗物质晕种子度规上的适用性、所得 Kerr-like 解的物理一致性，以及“消除本质曲率奇点”和超辐射抑制结论是否依赖特定剖面或近似条件。

papers.title: Proof of concept of the COSMOCal project at the IRAM 30m telescope
papers.abstract: This work reports on a test campaign conducted at the IRAM 30m telescope to validate the COSMOCal instrument, a novel concept for absolute calibration of polarization angle, beam properties, and instrumental efficiency. The development is motivated by the stringent calibration requirements of current and next-generation Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) experiments, whose goal is the precise measurement of CMB polarization. Such measurements are essential to probe fundamental physics, including the possible imprint of primordial inflation. The COSMOCal concept is designed as a space-borne calibration reference intended to provide a stable and absolute polarized signal observable simultaneously by multiple large-aperture ground-based observatories. Prior to any space deployment, a terrestrial prototype was developed and characterized in the laboratory, as reported in Ritacco et al. 2024. The results presented here describe the first validation of the system coupled to an antenna, carried out at the IRAM 30m telescope in September 2024. This campaign aimed at assessing the performance of the full instrument under realistic observational conditions, including its ability to reconstruct polarization observables and interface with a state-of-the-art millimeter-wave polarimeter.

analysis.title_zh: COSMOCal 项目在 IRAM 30 米望远镜上的概念验证
analysis.summary_zh: 论文报告 COSMOCal 项目在 IRAM 30m 望远镜上的概念验证测试，目标是验证一种用于偏振角、波束性质和仪器效率绝对定标的新型仪器。摘要称该地面原型已在真实观测条件下与天线和毫米波偏振仪耦合，并测试了其重建偏振观测量的能力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 偏振实验直接相关。未来 CMB B 模式和宇宙暴胀信号搜索高度依赖偏振角、波束和效率的绝对定标；稳定、可由多个大口径地面台站同时观测的偏振参考源若可行，将有助于降低仪器系统误差。
key_points: COSMOCal 旨在提供偏振角、波束性质和仪器效率的绝对定标。
摘要报告了 2024 年 9 月在 IRAM 30m 望远镜上的首次天线耦合验证。
测试目标包括在真实观测条件下重建偏振观测量，并与毫米波偏振仪接口。

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对测试中偏振角、波束和效率定标的误差预算、系统误差控制、与实验室表征的一致性，以及该地面验证能否外推到未来空间定标参考源。

papers.title: 3-form dark energy and cosmic birefringence
papers.abstract: 3-forms are interesting fields to study in the cosmological context for numerous reasons, such as being candidates for explaining inflation and dark energy. The background evolution of a 3-form field is similar to but distinguishable from a scalar field in an expanding universe, and its tensorial structure allows for unique couplings that cannot be experienced by canonical scalars. In this work, we explore the possibility that 3-form dark energy can explain cosmic birefringence. We consider two EFT-inspired couplings between the 3-form and the photon, and compute the birefringence angle $β$. We find that a dimension-6 gauge-invariant operator necessitates an extremely large coupling to explain $β\sim0.3^\circ$, the value suggested by observations of recent cosmic microwave background radiation. Conversely, a dimension-4 operator can accommodate $β\sim0.3^\circ$ at the expense exciting the longitudinal mode of the photon. Interestingly, demanding a self-consistent decoupling limit implies the photon mass lies within a few orders of magnitude of $H_0$. We also derive `universal' profiles for $β(z)$, finding the $β$ from the dimension-4 operator is insensitive to the form of the 3-form potential but is sensitive to the initial conditions. Contrarily, the dimension-6 operator is highly sensitive to the form of the potential. We finally compare the universal profiles to that of axion-like particle (ALP) dark energy and an ultralight massive 3-form, the latter obtained from numerically integrated cosmological histories consistent with $Λ$CDM up to low redshift. Our results show that birefringence from 3-form dark energy can both mimic that from an ALP or be distinguishable, depending on the field configuration in the early universe.

analysis.title_zh: 3-形式暗能量与宇宙双折射
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 3-形式暗能量能否产生近期 CMB 观测所暗示的宇宙双折射角 β≈0.3°，并计算两类 EFT 启发的 3-形式-光子耦合所给出的 β。摘要称 dimension-6 规范不变算符需要极大的耦合，而 dimension-4 算符可容纳该角度但会激发光子纵向模；作者还给出 β(z) 的“普适”剖面并与 ALP 暗能量及超轻有质量 3-形式情形比较。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙双折射通常通过 CMB 偏振的旋转角来检验宇称破缺或新场与光子的耦合；若 3-形式暗能量能产生可观测 β，它会把暗能量动力学、CMB 偏振系统学和新物理模型区分联系起来，并影响对 ALP 类解释的判别。
key_points: 探讨 3-形式暗能量是否可解释 CMB 指示的宇宙双折射角 β≈0.3°。
比较两个 EFT 启发的 3-形式-光子耦合：dimension-6 与 dimension-4 算符。
双折射红移剖面可在某些早期场构型下模拟 ALP 暗能量，也可能与之区分。

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对两个光子耦合的有效场论适用范围、dimension-4 算符激发光子纵向模与光子质量约束的自洽性、β(z) 对初始条件和势函数的敏感性，以及与 CMB 双折射观测量定义和系统误差处理的对应关系。

papers.title: Novel Signatures of Matter-Induced Dark Matter Decay in Large-Volume Neutrino Telescopes
papers.abstract: Large-volume neutrino telescopes offer a unique opportunity to search for decaying dark matter through events containing a pair of energetic, highly non-collimated muon tracks emerging from a common vertex. Such events would have negligible Standard Model backgrounds and would constitute a striking signature of new physics. Conventional dark matter annihilation or decay, however, is too strongly constrained to produce an observable rate of such events. We therefore consider scenarios in which an excited dark matter state is extremely long-lived in vacuum but decays much more rapidly in the presence of ordinary matter. We present two realizations of this mechanism. In the first, a long-range scalar field sourced by ordinary matter modifies the dark-sector mass spectrum, kinematically opening the decay $χ_2 \rightarrow χ_1 Z'$ near the Earth while leaving it forbidden in vacuum. In the second, the scalar background induces kinetic mixing between a heavy $Z'$ and the photon, greatly enhancing the three-body decay $χ_2\toχ_1μ^+μ^-$ in matter-rich environments. We calculate the resulting distributions of muon energies and opening angles and show that viable regions of parameter space can yield observable event rates in IceCube, KM3NeT, and other large-volume neutrino telescopes while remaining consistent with existing constraints. We also briefly consider the sensitivity of IceCube to multi-muon events produced by the decays of cosmologically long-lived charged particles with masses $\gtrsim 1$ TeV.

analysis.title_zh: 大体积中微子望远镜中物质诱导暗物质衰变的新颖信号
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究大体积中微子望远镜中由物质诱导暗物质衰变产生的双 μ 径迹信号，提出两种机制使激发态暗物质在普通物质附近快速衰变。摘要报告称，计算得到的 μ 子能量和张角分布显示，某些参数空间可在 IceCube、KM3NeT 等实验中给出可观测事件率且与现有约束相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作属于粒子宇宙学和多信使暗物质搜索，与 CMB 的联系主要体现在暗物质性质约束的互补性。CMB 对暗物质衰变、湮灭和能量注入有强约束，而这里关注在物质丰富环境中增强的衰变信号；精读时可比较其参数空间是否避开或补充 CMB 限制。
key_points: 提出在大体积中微子望远镜中寻找共顶点、双高能 μ 径迹的暗物质衰变信号。
机制核心是激发态暗物质在真空中极长寿命，但在普通物质环境中衰变显著加快。
摘要称某些可行参数空间可在 IceCube、KM3NeT 等实验中产生可观测事件率，并满足既有限制。
methods: 大体积中微子望远镜事件率估计
IceCube 和 KM3NeT 灵敏度讨论
物质诱导暗物质衰变模型
普通物质源长程标量场

宇宙学长寿命带电粒子多 μ 事件灵敏度简述
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对物质诱导机制与现有暗物质、第五力、动能混合和天体物理约束之间的相容性，以及“标准模型背景可忽略”和可观测事件率的实验选择效率假设。

papers.title: Axion-driven spontaneous leptogenesis, precisely
papers.abstract: We revisit a minimal scenario for spontaneous leptogenesis where the asymmetry generation is driven by a heavy axion-like field evolving via standard misalignment. We focus on the simplest framework in which lepton number violation originates from the dimension-five Weinberg operator and contributions from standard thermal leptogenesis become negligible. The asymmetry is computed by solving a set of transport equations, which incorporate fully flavor-dependent interaction rates for the Weinberg operator that are presented here for the first time. We also derive a simple algebraic master formula for the generated $B\!-\!L$ asymmetry, valid for arbitrary axion velocities and classically shift-symmetric couplings to the Standard Model, that reproduces the $B\!-\!L$-production dynamics of the full set of transport equations in controlled parameter regions. Along the way, we quantify the importance of low-scale neutrino masses and the two mass orderings on the final prediction for the generated asymmetry. Finally, we assess the cosmological viability of different axion couplings by accounting for entropy dilution from late-time axion decays and imposing constraints from baryonic isocurvature perturbations. We demonstrate that explaining the baryon asymmetry via standard Majoron misalignment is under severe tension due to dilution from late-time decays. In contrast, axions coupled to strong or weak sphalerons can successfully produce the observed asymmetry for decay constants near the energy scale of grand unification and axion oscillation temperatures $T_{\text{osc}} \gtrsim 10^{11\cdots12}$ GeV, provided a cosmological history featuring high-scale inflation and efficient reheating.

analysis.title_zh: 轴子驱动的自发轻子生成，精确处理
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新考察重轴子样场通过标准错位机制驱动的自发轻子生成，在 Weinberg 算符给出轻子数破坏且标准热轻子生成可忽略的框架中，用含全味相互作用率的输运方程计算不对称。摘要报告标准 Majoron 错位因晚期衰变稀释而面临严重张力，而耦合强或弱 sphaleron 的轴子可在接近大统一能标的衰变常数和很高振荡温度下产生观测到的重子不对称，并需高尺度暴胀和有效再加热的宇宙学历史。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接涉及早期宇宙重子不对称、轴子样场、暴胀后热史和重子等曲率扰动；其中等曲率扰动与再加热假设可被 CMB 强力约束，因此对用 CMB 检验粒子宇宙学重子生成模型具有明确相关性。
key_points: 重新分析由重轴子样场错位演化驱动的自发轻子生成。
包含 Weinberg 算符的全味相互作用率，并给出适用受控参数区的代数主公式。
标准 Majoron 错位因晚期衰变稀释而严重受张力；耦合强或弱 sphaleron 的轴子在高能标条件下可生成观测到的重子不对称。
methods: 标准错位机制下的重轴子样场演化
维五 Weinberg 算符导致的轻子数破坏
输运方程组求解
全味依赖 Weinberg 算符相互作用率
生成 B-L 不对称的代数主公式
熵稀释计算
重子等曲率扰动约束
低尺度中微子质量与两种质量排序影响评估
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对输运方程与代数主公式的适用参数区、等曲率约束如何依赖暴胀史，以及晚期轴子衰变导致的熵稀释是否覆盖了目标模型空间。

papers.title: Coupled quintessence from an axion dark sector
papers.abstract: Recent observational data arising from the DESI collaboration has hinted at a possible departure from the standard $Λ$CDM cosmological model, preferring instead the presence of a dynamical dark energy component. Specifically, the associated equation of state of the dark energy features a crossing into the so-called phantom regime, which is challenging to accommodate in canonical single scalar-field scenarios. However, this behavior can be effectively described by an interacting dark sector, where the specific dark energy equation of state remains above the phantom divide whilst the dark matter component deviates from the standard cold dark matter evolution. In this work, we explore this possibility in the context of an axion dark sector, where both the dark energy and dark matter are represented by two interacting axion-like fields. We show that given the required mass hierarchy for these fields to play such roles, their dynamics can be effectively placed in the coupled quintessence framework, where their motion follows from a sourced continuity equation in the fluid description. In this regime, we perform a statistical analysis of this scenario with current data, finding that a sub-Planckian dark energy axion decay constant stays well within the observational bounds without the need to fine-tune the associated field's initial conditions. We also perform a comparison with $Λ$CDM, where we find that the model provides a better fit to the data while staying competitive from a Bayesian perspective.

analysis.title_zh: 来自轴子暗部门的耦合 quintessence
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 DESI 等近期数据暗示的动态暗能量和表观 phantom crossing，提出用两个相互作用的类轴子场构成暗部门：暗能量本身不跨越 phantom divide，而由暗物质演化偏离标准 CDM 产生等效行为。摘要报告，在合适质量层级下该体系可归入耦合 quintessence，并且用当前数据统计分析时，亚普朗克暗能量轴子衰变常数可处于观测允许范围内，且相对 ΛCDM 给出更好拟合并在贝叶斯比较中保持竞争力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接关系到晚期宇宙学参数推断中对 ΛCDM 的扩展，尤其是暗能量状态方程、暗物质连续性方程和几何距离观测之间的退化。对 CMB 研究者而言，任何暗部门相互作用都会影响从早期宇宙锚定到晚期距离尺度、结构增长和综合数据联合拟合的解释，需要关注其是否与 CMB 约束兼容。
key_points: 用两个相互作用的类轴子场分别描述暗能量和暗物质。
在质量层级满足角色要求时，动力学可等效为耦合 quintessence 流体框架。
摘要称当前数据下该模型拟合优于 ΛCDM，贝叶斯角度仍具竞争力。
methods: 耦合 quintessence 框架
流体描述中的含源连续性方程
当前观测数据的统计分析
与 ΛCDM 的模型比较
轴子/类轴子暗部门模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对所用“当前数据”的具体组合、DESI 信息如何进入似然分析、耦合项与轴子势的参数化是否导致等效暗物质演化退化，以及所谓贝叶斯竞争力依赖何种先验。

papers.title: Characterising the epoch of reionisation using the cross-correlation of the kSZ effect and CMB lensing
papers.abstract: We investigate the cross-correlation of the kinematic Sunyaev-Zeldovich (kSZ) effect with lensing of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) as a probe of the epoch of reionisation. During reionisation, bubbles of ionised electrons form around overdensities, generating temperature perturbations in the CMB via the kSZ effect, which correlate with the projected matter density field probed by CMB lensing. We demonstrate using AMBER simulations that this effect can be probed via cross-correlating the squared kSZ field with the CMB lensing potential, and that the signal is sensitive to the duration and midpoint of reionisation. We forecast that for a Simons Observatory-like experiment with 5$μ$K-arcmin white noise, covering 40% of the sky, the signal could be marginally detected at $S/N$ = 2 to 3. Meanwhile, a futuristic experiment like CMB-HD could provide a measurement of $S/N \sim 50$, yielding informative constraints on reionisation scenarios. We investigate potential challenges in measuring the signal and explore mitigation for each: contamination from extragalactic foregrounds at low redshift, contamination of the kSZ-squared estimator by lensing, and other estimator biases.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 kSZ 效应与 CMB 透镜的互相关刻画再电离时期
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究运动学 Sunyaev-Zeldovich 效应与 CMB 透镜的互相关，作为再电离时期的探针。摘要称 AMBER 模拟表明 kSZ 平方场与 CMB 透镜势的互相关对再电离持续时间和中点敏感，并预报 SO 类实验可边缘探测、CMB-HD 类实验可获得高信噪测量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离历史影响 CMB 大尺度偏振和光学深度，而 kSZ 与 CMB 透镜互相关提供了与低阶 E 模不同的再电离信息来源；这对未来 CMB 实验联合约束再电离模型和控制次级各向异性前景很重要。
key_points: 研究 kSZ 平方场与 CMB 透镜势的互相关作为再电离探针。
AMBER 模拟显示信号对再电离持续时间和中点敏感。
摘要给出 SO 类实验边缘探测、CMB-HD 类实验高信噪测量的预报，并讨论多类偏差与前景污染。
methods: AMBER simulations
kSZ 平方场与 CMB lensing potential 互相关
Simons Observatory-like 实验预报：5 μK-arcmin 白噪声、40% 天区
CMB-HD 类未来实验预报
外星系前景污染、透镜污染和估计量偏差的缓解研究
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 kSZ-squared 估计量的构造、低红移外星系前景与透镜泄漏的建模和缓解是否足以支撑再电离参数预报。

papers.title: Is Dark Matter Really Matter?
papers.abstract: In the standard model of cosmology, it is assumed that dark matter is pressureless with equation of state $w=0$ and dark energy has $w=-1$. We test these assumptions jointly using DESI DR2 distance measurements, including the recent Lyman-$α$ full-shape Alcock-Paczynski (AP) information, DES supernovae, and two complementary CMB treatment. When constant $w_{dm}$ and $w_{de}$ are varied together, we find $w_{dm}=0.000968^{+0.000501}_{-0.000496}$ and $w_{de}=-0.9380^{+0.0259}_{-0.0262}$ (68%). With an alternative CMB treatment that marginalizes over the lensing spectrum, the corresponding constraints are $w_{dm}=0.000870^{+0.000408}_{-0.000410}$ and $w_{de}=-0.9353^{+0.0258}_{-0.0254}$. Both standard $Λ$CDM values are disfavored at approximately $2σ$ in the joint extension. Neither parameter departs significantly from its standard value when only that parameter is varied. This behavior arises because late-time distances favor $w_{de}>-1$, while maintaining the early-Universe physical matter density requires a compensating positive $w_{dm}$, which changes the mapping to the matter density today. Allowing dynamical dark energy clarify further on complexity of the situation: phantom crossing for dark energy makes $w_{dm}=0$ consistent with the data, whereas a positive $w_{dm}$ preference persists when crossing is forbidden. Interestingly, the Pad'e-$w$ parameterization that provides a flexible description of a class of quintessence models (with no phantom crossing), along with $w_{dm}$ free, is even mildly favored over the phantom-crossing $w_0w_a$ model according to both the best-fit $χ^2$ and the DIC under both CMB treatments. One can conclude that the apparent preference for phantom crossing may instead reflect deviations in the dark-matter sector rather than dark-energy dynamics alone. [abridged]

analysis.title_zh: 暗物质真的是“物质”吗？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文联合检验标准宇宙学中暗物质无压 w_dm=0 与暗能量 w_de=-1 的假设，使用 DESI DR2 距离、Lyman-α full-shape AP 信息、DES 超新星和两种 CMB 处理。摘要报告在同时放开常数 w_dm 与 w_de 时，标准 ΛCDM 值约在 2σ 水平不受偏好；但单独放开任一参数时不显著偏离，并指出 phantom crossing 与非零 w_dm 的解释存在退化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文触及 CMB 参数推断中的核心假设：早期宇宙物理物质密度如何映射到晚期距离和结构观测中的今日物质密度。如果暗物质具有微小非零状态方程，它可能改变 CMB 与 DESI、超新星等晚期数据联合拟合时对暗能量动态性或 phantom crossing 的解释。
key_points: 联合放开暗物质和暗能量常数状态方程时，摘要报告二者相对标准值出现约 2σ 偏离。
当只改变其中一个参数时，摘要称没有显著偏离标准值。
动态暗能量情形下，是否允许 phantom crossing 会影响对 wdm 的偏好解释。

Lyman-α full-shape Alcock-Paczynski 信息
DES 超新星
两种互补 CMB 处理

联合变化常数 w_dm 与 w_de

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 w_dm 非零如何影响早期物理物质密度到今日物质密度的映射、两种 CMB 处理尤其是 lensing spectrum 边缘化的定义，以及所报告约 2σ 偏离是否受模型参数化和先验驱动。

papers.title: A smooth BTZ black bounce with an extremal null throat
papers.abstract: We study a static, circularly symmetric deformation of the non-rotating BTZ black hole obtained by inserting a smooth transition function into the \emph{inverse} radial metric component, $g^{rr}=S_δ(r)F(r)$ with $S_δ=\tanh[(r-r_h)/δ]$, leaving $g_{tt}=-F$ untouched. This was motivated by the proposal that such a construction realizes a Lorentzian-to-Riemannian signature change at the horizon; we show that it does not. In coordinates $r-r_h=q^2$ with an advanced time, the metric extends real-analytically across $r=r_h$, and the extension is Lorentzian: $q=0$ is a regular null hypersurface, a degenerate Killing horizon with vanishing surface gravity, beyond which lies a second, isometric copy of the exterior. The areal radius has a minimum there, so the geometry is a black bounce; the would-be Riemannian branch is a separate geometry the Lorentzian sector never reaches. We give the effective source in closed form, an invariant account of the energy conditions, and identify the near-throat geometry as AdS$_2\times S^1$. The scalar effective potential is proven strictly positive for every mode, and the throat circle is a minimal surface whose length gives an entropy $πr_h/2G$, reproduced independently by the Wald--Noether charge and by a Cardy estimate from the computed Brown--York mass -- concordant results for which no first law is available since $κ=0$. The throat carries an Aretakis-type instability, with a conserved leading transverse derivative and a linearly growing subleading one. We also record a negative result: smoothing $g_{tt}$ instead, as in the Lorentzian-Euclidean Schwarzschild proposal, is singular at the horizon for any finite smoothing width. We state explicitly what the construction does not establish.

analysis.title_zh: 具有极端零测地喉部的平滑 BTZ 黑洞反弹
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一种对非旋转 BTZ 黑洞的平滑形变，作者指出该构造并不实现地平线处的洛伦兹-黎曼签名改变，而是在适当坐标中可实解析延拓为洛伦兹几何。摘要报告其结果是具有极端零测地喉部的 black bounce，并给出有效源、能量条件、近喉部几何、熵估计和 Aretakis 型不稳定性等分析。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要属于经典引力和低维黑洞几何，并非直接面向 CMB 数据分析。它与宇宙学的联系更多在理论引力层面，例如时空正则化、地平线结构和有效能量条件，这些主题可为量子引力或早期宇宙奇点替代理论提供背景，但摘要未显示其对 CMB 可观测量有直接影响。

papers.title: Revisiting the equation of state of dark energy from DESI BAO with SNe Ia and CMB
papers.abstract: The Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) measurements of baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) have recently shown a mild preference for dynamical dark energy over the standard $\rm Λ$CDM model. In this paper, we analyze the $w_0w_a$CDM model using DESI BAO DR2, Pantheon+ SNe Ia, and Planck 2018 CMB distance prior data. To examine how different parts of the data affect the apparent deviation from $\rm Λ$CDM, we adopt two complementary redshift-cut strategies, dividing the dataset into $z<z_{\rm cut}$ and $z>z_{\rm cut}$ subsamples. We find that the most noticeable shifts occur when BAO and SNe Ia data in the redshift range $z\sim0.4$--$0.8$ are included, reaching a significance of about $\sim2σ$. Within this framework, the inclusion of higher-redshift measurements progressively weakens this deviation and brings the constraints closer to the $\rm Λ$CDM expectation. Moreover, the information criteria show no statistically significant preference between the $w_0w_a$CDM and $\rm Λ$CDM models, while the Bayesian information criterion consistently favors the $\rm Λ$CDM model. In addition, a parameter-shift consistency test reveals no statistically significant tension between complementary redshift subsamples. Within the DESI BAO DR2, Pantheon+, and CMB distance prior framework adopted here, these results do not provide statistically robust evidence favoring the $w_0w_a$CDM model over $\rm Λ$CDM. They instead indicate that the apparent parameter shifts under different redshift cuts may be affected by statistical fluctuations and by the limited precision and number of datapoints in the current subsamples. Our analysis provides a complementary redshift-dependent diagnostic for assessing how the inferred cosmological constraints vary under different redshift selections.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 DESI BAO、Ia 型超新星和 CMB 重新考察暗能量状态方程
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 DESI BAO DR2、Pantheon+ 超新星和 Planck 2018 CMB distance prior 重新检验 w0waCDM 暗能量状态方程，并通过两种红移切分策略追踪不同红移数据对偏离 ΛCDM 的贡献。摘要报告 z≈0.4–0.8 的 BAO 与超新星数据带来最明显、约 2σ 的偏移，但加入更高红移数据会削弱该偏离，且信息准则和参数一致性检验不支持 w0waCDM 相对 ΛCDM 的稳健证据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作评估 DESI BAO 所提示的动态暗能量迹象是否能在结合超新星和 CMB 距离先验后保持稳健。对 CMB 宇宙学而言，它关系到 Planck 标定的距离尺度与低红移 BAO/SNe 数据是否共同要求偏离 ΛCDM，或只是当前红移子样本中的统计波动。

红移切分显示 z≈0.4–0.8 数据纳入时参数偏移最明显，摘要称约 2σ。
信息准则未支持 w0waCDM 相对 ΛCDM 的稳健优势，BIC 一贯偏好 ΛCDM。

papers.title: Cosmology in the Einstein Telescope era: comparing traditional and simulation-based methods for population inference
papers.abstract: The next generation of gravitational wave detectors, such as the Einstein Telescope (ET), will observe orders of magnitude more binary black hole mergers than current facilities. Most of these events will lack an electromagnetic counterpart, also known as dark siren events, yet will still enable percent-level cosmological constraints. However, the likelihood traditionally used in Hierarchical Bayesian Inference (HBI) for population-level analyses becomes computationally prohibitive as the size of dark siren catalogues and population parameters grow. In this work we compare HBI against simulation-based inference (SBI) as a scalable alternative for cosmological population inference in the ET era. Studying a proof-of-concept example of a mock ET inference, we build a catalogue of $O(10^4)$ binary black hole events, then perform inference on the Hubble constant $H_0$ and matter density $Ω_m$ in a flat $Λ$CDM cosmology, using both a hierarchical analytical likelihood and Marginal Neural Ratio Estimation (MNRE). We find excellent agreement between the two approaches, with SBI reproducing the HBI posteriors to high accuracy, while requiring orders of magnitude less computation once the simulation and training cost is amortized. We further demonstrate that SBI extends straightforwardly to a joint cosmology-plus-astrophysics analysis, simultaneously constraining $(H_0,Ω_m)$ together with the parameters of the star formation rate density, at negligible additional cost compared to the significant increase in complexity such an extension would require within the HBI framework. Our results indicate that SBI is a promising and scalable tool for population inference with third-generation GW detectors.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 8 figures. Links to codes: Sireeni: https://github.com/GFAbellan/Sireeni, darksirens_hbi: https://gitlab.com/gantinoz/darksirens_hbi

analysis.title_zh: Einstein Telescope 时代的宇宙学：比较用于总体推断的传统方法与基于模拟的方法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 Einstein Telescope 时代大量无电磁对应体的双黑洞“暗标准汽笛”事件如何用于宇宙学总体推断，并比较传统分层贝叶斯推断与基于模拟的推断。摘要报告，在一个约 O(10^4) 事件的模拟 ET 概念验证中，MNRE 能高精度复现 HBI 对平直 ΛCDM 中 H0 和 Ωm 的后验，并在训练成本摊销后显著节省计算，还可低额外成本扩展到联合约束星形成率密度参数。

在模拟的约 O(10^4) 双黑洞事件目录上比较 HBI 与 SBI。
摘要称 MNRE 能高精度复现 HBI 后验，并在摊销训练成本后显著降低计算量。

papers.title: A Tale of Two Couplings: Bayesian Selection in the Interacting Dark Sector
papers.abstract: $Λ$CDM provides a remarkably successful description of the Universe, yet it suffers from persistent discrepancies, with one of the most prominent being the $σ_8$ tension between early-Universe Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) measurements and late-time structure growth probes. To address this mismatch, we investigate generalized interacting dark sector models governed by a quintessence field coupled to dark matter via conformal and disformal transformations. By generically engineering a quintessence potential that ensures the combined evolution of dark matter and dark energy exactly mimics $Λ$CDM, our models satisfy all background constraints while signaling modified gravity effects within the linear perturbation sector. We perform a statistical analysis using late-time structure growth data anchored to Planck 2018 constraints. Furthermore, we address the initial conditions problem inherent to purely disformal models, demonstrating the necessity of a non-zero initial kinetic energy to initiate dynamical evolution. Our results indicate that purely conformal couplings efficiently transfer energy from dark matter to the quintessence field, suppressing late-time structure formation and successfully accommodating CMB data within late-time modified structure growth. This purely conformal limit yields a strong statistical preference over the $Λ$CDM baseline according to both the Akaike and Bayesian Information Criteria. Conversely, while non-zero disformal couplings introduce a kinetic friction that dampens the dark sector energy exchange, their expanded parameter space incurs heavy statistical penalties without providing a decisive improvement over the purely conformal scenario.

analysis.title_zh: 两个耦合的故事：相互作用暗扇区中的贝叶斯选择
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由 quintessence 场通过共形和 disformal 变换耦合暗物质的广义相互作用暗扇区模型，用工程化势函数使背景演化精确模拟 ΛCDM，并用锚定 Planck 2018 的晚期结构增长数据做统计分析。摘要报告纯共形耦合可将能量从暗物质转移到 quintessence 场、抑制晚期结构形成，并在 AIC 与 BIC 下相对 ΛCDM 获得强偏好；而 disformal 耦合虽带来动能摩擦，但未给出相对纯共形情形的决定性改进。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接针对 CMB 推断的早期宇宙 σ8 与晚期结构增长之间的不一致，试图在不改变 ΛCDM 背景距离演化的前提下，通过暗扇区相互作用改变线性扰动和结构增长。对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于它如何使用 Planck 2018 约束作为锚点，并判断晚期增长数据是否真的支持相互作用暗扇区而非标准 ΛCDM。
key_points: 构造与 ΛCDM 背景演化完全一致的相互作用暗扇区模型。
纯共形耦合在摘要中被报告为可抑制晚期结构形成，并相对 ΛCDM 获得 AIC/BIC 偏好。
非零 disformal 耦合引入动能摩擦，但因参数空间扩大受到信息准则惩罚。
methods: quintessence 场与暗物质的共形和 disformal 变换耦合

papers.title: First fast radio burst search campaign at the Argentine Institute of Radio Astronomy
papers.abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are intense millisecond-duration radio transients of extragalactic origin whose physical nature remains under active investigation, and which also serve as probes of the intergalactic medium. We report on the first FRB search campaign carried out at the Argentine Institute of Radio Astronomy (IAR) between December 2024 and March 2026, targeting nearby galaxy superclusters in the southern sky. We observed fields in the Ophiuchus, Shapley, and Sculptor/Phoenix supercluster regions with one of the two 30~m antennas of the IAR, using a ROACH-based backend with 400~MHz of bandwidth centred at 1400~MHz and a time resolution of 41--82~$μ$s, for a total net observing time of 212~h. The data were searched for dispersed single pulses with \texttt{PRESTO} in the dispersion measure range $100 \leq \mathrm{DM} \leq 500$, and candidates were classified with the FETCH machine learning classifier. The pipeline was validated on archival Parkes data containing known FRBs and on synthetic bursts injected into IAR observations. One FRB candidate, FRB~20251018, was identified on 18 October 2025 in an observation pointed towards the galaxy cluster A2870, in the Phoenix supercluster, with a dispersion measure of $243$, a signal-to-noise ratio of 8.2, and a FETCH probability of $p=0.99$. To the best of our knowledge, this would be the first FRB detected from South America. A set of more marginal candidates is also presented. These results demonstrate the capability of the IAR antennas to detect FRBs and support the continuation and extension of the monitoring campaign, including coincident dual-antenna observations and cross-matches with gravitational-wave events and electromagnetic transients.

analysis.title_zh: 阿根廷射电天文研究所的首次快速射电暴搜索项目
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告阿根廷射电天文研究所首次 FRB 搜索项目，使用 IAR 30 m 天线对南天邻近超星系团区域进行 212 小时观测，并用 PRESTO 与 FETCH 筛选色散单脉冲。摘要称识别出一个指向 Phoenix 超星系团 A2870 附近的 FRB 候选体 FRB 20251018，并验证了 IAR 天线开展 FRB 搜索的能力。

papers.title: Integrated cosmological memory: A dark-siren method to probe dark energy
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave (GW) cosmology is currently bottlenecked by the scarcity of electromagnetic counterparts for bright sirens and the systematic uncertainties of galaxy catalogs for dark sirens. We propose a purely gravitational resolution using the Integrated Cosmological Memory (ICM)-the cumulative GW strain encoded in the spacetime geometry of an expanding Universe. While the GW transient emitted by the source provides the luminosity distance, the ICM accumulates a mathematically distinct integral of the cosmic expansion history. We demonstrate that extracting both observables from a single binary merger completely breaks the distance-redshift degeneracy within the gravitational sector. This establishes a novel, catalog-free dark siren framework for third-generation GW detector networks. Crucially, the resulting constraints on late-time dark energy are only weakly sensitive to the local expansion rate, providing a robust cosmological probe that can potentially mitigate the impact of the H0 tension.
papers.comment: Submitted to Astrophysical Journal Letters. 16 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables

analysis.title_zh: 综合宇宙学记忆：一种探测暗能量的暗标准汽笛方法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出用综合宇宙学记忆，即膨胀宇宙时空几何中累积的引力波应变，构建一种不依赖电磁对应体或星系目录的暗标准汽笛方法。摘要称，单个双星并合的瞬态引力波给出光度距离，而 ICM 提供对膨胀史的另一个积分观测量，两者可在引力部门内打破距离-红移简并并用于约束晚期暗能量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量和 H0 张力是 CMB 宇宙学的核心议题；若这种纯引力暗汽笛方法可行，它将为 CMB 推断的晚期膨胀史和暗能量约束提供独立交叉检验，并可能帮助区分本地 H0 测量与早期宇宙推断之间的系统差异。

单个双星并合中，瞬态引力波给出光度距离，ICM 给出不同的宇宙膨胀史积分。

papers.title: How Dilatation Invariance Suppresses Loop Corrections to Curvature Perturbations on CMB Scales
papers.abstract: Departures from standard slow-roll (SR) inflation have attracted increasing interest in recent years. In particular, scenarios that strongly enhance the power spectrum of the curvature perturbation are often proposed as a mechanism for producing primordial black holes, which could account for part or the totality of dark matter. An ongoing debate in these models is whether non-linear interactions of cosmological perturbations on small scales, namely loop corrections, can become sufficiently large to backreact on CMB scales. In this work, we adopt a non-linear framework, dropping spatial-gradient terms, to study loop corrections at super-Hubble scales. Our focus is to clarify the role of spatial-diffeomorphism invariance, especially dilatation invariance, which is the symmetry under overall rescaling of spatial coordinates, in demonstrating the suppression of loop corrections to the CMB power spectrum. This analysis is valid for any inflaton potential, both with smooth and sharp transitions, and at any loop order, as long as the CMB scales cross the horizon during an SR phase. We compare this result with the different explanations proposed in the literature using various gauge choices, and show our analysis is consistent both in the comoving and in the spatially-flat gauges. In particular, we show that in the spatially-flat gauge, the cubic interaction contains a term that diverges in the sharp transition limit. However, this contribution is exactly cancelled by the quartic interaction.
papers.comment: 20 pages main text, 4 pages appendix, 8 figures

analysis.title_zh: 膨胀不变性如何抑制 CMB 尺度曲率扰动的环修正
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论非标准慢滚暴胀中，小尺度曲率扰动增强所导致的非线性环修正是否会影响 CMB 尺度功率谱。作者在忽略空间梯度项的非线性超哈勃框架中，利用空间微分同胚不变性尤其是膨胀不变性，摘要称证明了只要 CMB 模式在慢滚阶段出视界，CMB 功率谱的环修正在任意势形、平滑或尖锐跃迁及任意环阶下受到抑制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接针对 CMB 尺度扰动的理论稳健性：若产生原初黑洞的模型在小尺度显著增强功率谱，环修正是否污染 CMB 功率谱会影响这类暴胀模型与 CMB 观测约束之间的连接。摘要给出的对称性论证若成立，可为使用 CMB 功率谱约束含小尺度增强的暴胀模型提供重要理论依据。
key_points: 研究小尺度增强曲率扰动模型中环修正是否会反作用到 CMB 尺度。
强调空间微分同胚不变性，特别是膨胀不变性，对 CMB 功率谱环修正的抑制作用。
摘要称结果适用于任意暴胀势、平滑或尖锐跃迁、任意环阶，条件是 CMB 尺度在慢滚阶段出视界。
methods: 忽略空间梯度项的非线性框架
超哈勃尺度环修正分析
空间微分同胚不变性与膨胀不变性分析
共动规范与空间平直规范比较
三次与四次相互作用项的抵消分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对其“忽略空间梯度项”的适用范围，以及从膨胀不变性推出任意环阶抑制的推导是否依赖边界项、规范选择或慢滚出视界条件；还要检查尖锐跃迁极限中三次发散项与四次项精确抵消的具体机制。

papers.title: Modified Cosmological Expansion and the JWST CMB Optical Depth Tension in Self Interaction Gravity
papers.abstract: Recent James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) observations favor an earlier and more efficient reionization history, leading to Thomson-scattering optical depths larger than those inferred from the cosmic microwave background (CMB). We investigate whether this tension can be alleviated within the framework of self-interaction (SI) gravity by modifying the cosmological expansion history while retaining the standard astrophysical description of reionization. The SI gravity parameters are constrained through a Bayesian MCMC analysis of the Union3 Type Ia supernova and DESI DR2 Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) data. The resulting expansion history is then used to predict the ionization history and Thomson optical depth. We find that the predicted optical depth decreases from $τ_{\rm{CMB}}\simeq0.076$ in $Λ$CDM to $τ_{\rm{CMB}}\simeq0.061$, consistent with the Planck PR4 measurement within $1σ$, thereby substantially reducing the optical-depth tension.

analysis.title_zh: 自相互作用引力中的修正宇宙学膨胀与 JWST-CMB 光学深度张力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 JWST 偏好的更早、更高效再电离是否会与 CMB Thomson 光学深度形成张力，并在自相互作用引力框架下通过修改宇宙膨胀史来缓解该问题。作者用 Union3 SNIa 和 DESI DR2 BAO 对模型参数做 Bayesian MCMC 约束，再预测电离历史与光学深度；摘要称预测 τ 从 ΛCDM 的约 0.076 降至约 0.061，与 Planck PR4 在 1σ 内一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 大尺度 E 模偏振对再电离光学深度高度敏感，因此任何试图调和 JWST 早期星系结果与 Planck 光学深度的模型都会影响 CMB 参数推断和再电离历史解释。该文把张力归因的一部分放在背景膨胀史而非单纯天体物理效率上，因而与 CMB 再电离约束直接相关。
key_points: 论文针对 JWST 暗示的较早再电离与 CMB 推断光学深度之间的张力。
作者在自相互作用引力框架中改变宇宙膨胀史，同时保留标准再电离天体物理描述。
摘要称该模型将预测的 Thomson 光学深度从 ΛCDM 的约 0.076 降至约 0.061，并与 Planck PR4 在 1σ 内一致。
methods: 自相互作用引力框架
修改宇宙学膨胀史
标准再电离天体物理描述
Bayesian MCMC 分析
Union3 Ia 型超新星数据
DESI DR2 BAO 数据
用所得膨胀史预测电离历史和 Thomson 光学深度
与 Planck PR4 光学深度测量比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 JWST 推断再电离历史与 CMB 光学深度张力的定义、SI 引力参数如何由低红移数据外推到再电离时期，以及标准再电离天体物理假设是否足以支撑 τ 的下降。

papers.title: Fermionic Dark Matter in a Scotogenic Model with a Complex Scalar Singlet
papers.abstract: We study the phenomenology of the complex scoto-singlet model, an extension of the scotogenic framework that simultaneously accounts for radiative neutrino masses and fermionic dark matter. We perform a Markov Chain Monte Carlo scan of the parameter space, imposing theoretical consistency together with constraints from neutrino oscillation data, lepton-flavor violation, collider searches and the observed dark matter relic abundance. Viable dark matter solutions are found both near the Higgs resonance and in coannihilation regions, extending the allowed mass range with respect to the minimal scotogenic model. Direct- and indirect-detection signals are strongly suppressed, placing most of the viable parameter space beyond the reach of current experiments. At colliders, monojet searches offer the best prospects to probe our model in compressed-spectrum scenarios, while long-lived charged scalars may give rise to displaced or detector-stable signatures.

analysis.title_zh: 含复标量单重态的 Scotogenic 模型中的费米子暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究复 scoto-singlet 模型中的费米子暗物质，该模型同时解释辐射产生的中微子质量和暗物质。作者通过 MCMC 扫描并加入理论一致性、中微子振荡、轻子味破坏、对撞机搜索和暗物质遗迹丰度等约束，摘要报告可行解出现在 Higgs 共振附近及共湮灭区域，且多数参数空间的直接和间接探测信号很弱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接处理 CMB 各向异性或早期宇宙扰动，但与宇宙学暗物质组成有关；其暗物质遗迹丰度约束与 CMB 推断的宇宙暗物质密度背景相关。对 CMB 读者而言，它主要提供粒子暗物质模型层面的候选机制和实验可检验性，而不是 CMB 数据分析方法。
key_points: 研究带复标量单重态的 scoto-singlet 模型。
用 MCMC 扫描并联合中微子、轻子味破坏、对撞机和暗物质遗迹丰度约束。
可行暗物质区域主要出现在 Higgs 共振附近和共湮灭区域，直接与间接探测信号被强烈压低。
methods: Markov Chain Monte Carlo 参数空间扫描
理论一致性约束
中微子振荡数据约束
轻子味破坏约束
对撞机搜索约束
观测暗物质遗迹丰度约束
直接探测、间接探测与 monojet/长寿命带电标量信号讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对参数扫描的先验、似然实现和约束组合方式，特别是遗迹丰度、轻子味破坏与压缩谱对撞机限制如何共同决定可行区域；还需确认“当前实验难以覆盖”的结论是否依赖特定参数选择。

papers.title: Discovery of the Distant, Ultra-Faint Milky Way Satellite Aquarius IV with the Vera C. Rubin Observatory Early Data Preview 2
papers.abstract: We present the discovery of Aquarius IV (Rubin J2201$-$0234) -- the first ultra-faint Milky Way satellite to be identified using data from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory. This system was detected at $\sim$8$σ$ significance using Rubin Early Data Preview 2 (EDP2) photometry and independently confirmed at $\sim$6$σ$ significance in archival Dark Energy Camera imaging. Jointly fitting its morphology and distance, we find that Aquarius IV is a low-luminosity ($M_V=-1.9^{+0.6}_{-1.0}$), compact ($r_{1/2} = 19^{+4}_{-6}$ pc; $r_h = 0.60^{+0.14}_{-0.17}$ arcmin) stellar system in the outer Galactic halo ($D_{\odot} = 109^{+6}_{-8}\ \mathrm{kpc}$). Its stellar population is consistent with an ancient, metal-poor stellar isochrone ($τ= 13$ Gyr, $Z=0.0001$). These properties closely resemble those of the smallest and faintest confirmed ultra-faint dwarf galaxies, though a globular cluster classification is not ruled out. Given the small number of detected member stars in Rubin EDP2, deeper imaging and spectroscopy will be critical for determining the properties and classification of Aquarius IV at higher confidence.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 figure; submitted to Research Notes of the AAS. Supplemental figures (skymap, size-luminosity plane, DECam cutout) available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21754874

analysis.title_zh: 利用 Vera C. Rubin 天文台早期数据预览 2 发现遥远的超暗弱银河系卫星 Aquarius IV
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告利用 Vera C. Rubin Observatory Early Data Preview 2 发现新的遥远超暗弱银河系卫星 Aquarius IV，并用 Dark Energy Camera 档案成像独立确认。摘要称联合拟合显示它是外银河晕中低光度、致密、古老且贫金属的恒星系统，性质接近最小最暗的超暗弱矮星系，但尚不能排除球状星团解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要属于近场宇宙学和星系天体物理，对 CMB 研究是间接相关：银河系卫星数量和性质可检验暗物质小尺度结构，与 CMB 所约束的宇宙学模型在小尺度上的延伸有关。它不直接影响 CMB 初级各向异性，但有助于连接早期宇宙参数与晚期结构形成。
key_points: 报告 Rubin Observatory 早期数据中发现一个新的超暗弱银河系卫星候选体 Aquarius IV。
用 Rubin EDP2 测光发现，并由 DECam 档案成像独立确认。
其性质类似最小、最暗的超暗弱矮星系，但摘要称球状星团分类尚不能排除。
methods: Vera C. Rubin Observatory Early Data Preview 2 测光数据
Dark Energy Camera 档案成像独立确认
形态与距离联合拟合
恒星等龄线匹配
更深成像和光谱作为后续需求
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对成员星选择、背景建模、显著性估计和形态-距离联合拟合的假设；分类上尤其要看是否有动力学或金属丰度证据足以区分超暗弱矮星系与球状星团。

papers.title: Effective reheating in Gauss--Bonnet inflation with $μ(φ,X)$ coupling
papers.abstract: We study effective reheating in a scalar--Gauss--Bonnet inflationary model with a phase-space-dependent coupling $μ(φ,X)$, in which a compact field-space feature is combined with a bounded kinetic gate. The modified inflationary background determines the pivot-scale quantities and the effective energy density at the end of inflation. These quantities are then used to derive the reheating duration $N_{\rm re}$ and temperature $T_{\rm re}$ through the thermal-history matching relation. We first perform two fixed-pivot reference scans by varying the overall Gauss--Bonnet strength $λ_{\rm GB}$ and the kinetic parameter $g_{_X}$ separately. For the reference parameter choices, increasing either parameter increases $N_{\rm re}$ and decreases $T_{\rm re}$ for the selected reheating equations of state. Additional benchmark calculations clarify how these variations depend on the dynamical regime of the model. In the $λ_{\rm GB}$ scan, the increase in $N_{\rm re}$ and the decrease in $T_{\rm re}$ persist, although both variations become strongly suppressed when the coupling is more localized or when the end of inflation is controlled more strongly by the E-model potential. In the $g_{_X}$ scan, stronger field-space localization and kinetic saturation can instead lead to a slight decrease in $N_{\rm re}$ and an increase in $T_{\rm re}$ as $g_{_X}$ is increased. When the bounded kinetic contribution is considered together with a weaker overall Gauss--Bonnet interaction, the resulting changes in the reheating quantities become nearly negligible. The fixed-pivot predictions of the representative and alternative benchmarks are compared with CMB constraints.These reheating constraints are then discussed for four representative values of the effective equation-of-state parameter, $\overline{w}_{\rm re}=-1/3,0,2/3,$ and $1$.

analysis.title_zh: 具有 μ(φ,X) 耦合的 Gauss--Bonnet 暴胀中的有效再加热
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究带有相空间依赖耦合 μ(φ,X) 的标量--Gauss--Bonnet 暴胀模型中有效再加热的持续时间和温度。摘要称，作者用修正后的暴胀背景和热史匹配关系扫描 λ_GB 与 g_X，发现参考情形下增大任一参数会增加 N_re、降低 T_re，但在更局域耦合、动能饱和或较弱 Gauss--Bonnet 相互作用时该趋势可被压低、反转或变得近乎可忽略。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再加热连接暴胀末期与热大爆炸初始条件，并影响把 CMB pivot 尺度观测量映射到暴胀模型参数的方式。该文把 Gauss--Bonnet 修正和动能门控对再加热量的影响与 CMB 约束比较，因此对用 CMB 检验修正引力或非标准暴胀模型的读者有直接关联。
key_points: 研究带相空间依赖 Gauss--Bonnet 耦合 μ(φ,X) 的暴胀模型中的有效再加热。
通过热史匹配关系推导再加热持续时间 N_re 与温度 T_re。
摘要报告不同 λ_GB、g_X 扫描下 N_re 与 T_re 的变化，并与 CMB 约束比较。
methods: 标量--Gauss--Bonnet 暴胀模型
相空间依赖耦合 μ(φ,X)
固定 pivot 参考扫描
热史匹配关系
四个有效再加热状态方程参数：-1/3、0、2/3、1
与 CMB 约束比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对热史匹配中使用的 pivot 量、暴胀末有效能量密度和状态方程假设是否自洽，以及所谓“固定 pivot”预测与 CMB 约束比较时采用了哪些观测量和先验。

papers.title: Axion Inflation: Perturbative control in the strong backreaction regime
papers.abstract: We study the strong backreaction regime in axion inflation, in which the friction from Abelian gauge fields generated via the pseudo-scalar interaction $\fracβ{4 M_p} φF {\tilde F}$ is comparable to Hubble friction. The non-linear dynamics associated with the gauge fields render this regime phenomenologically particularly interesting, but also notoriously difficult to study with perturbative methods. Quantifying the perturbative control through the direct impact on the spectral backreaction using (i) a first-order gradient-expansion formalism including axion gradients, and (ii) a one-loop in-in calculation, we discover an extended mild backreaction regime at large couplings $β$, with a relatively large, nearly constant particle production parameter $ξ$. In passing, we point out that CMB non-Gaussianity bounds impose a general upper limit on the product of axion gauge field coupling and Hubble parameter during inflation, $βH/M_p < 1.4\cdot 10^{-3}$, independently of the choice of the axion potential.

analysis.title_zh: 轴子暴胀：强反作用区域中的微扰可控性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究轴子暴胀中由赝标量耦合产生的 Abelian 规范场在强反作用区域对微扰可控性的影响。摘要称，作者用含轴子梯度的一阶梯度展开和 one-loop in-in 计算量化谱反作用，发现大耦合 β 下存在扩展的温和反作用区域，并指出 CMB 非高斯性界限给出与轴子势选择无关的 βH/M_p < 1.4×10^{-3}。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 轴子--规范场耦合可产生非平庸的标量、张量扰动和非高斯性，是 CMB 对暴胀相互作用进行约束的重要场景。该文直接讨论 CMB 非高斯性对耦合强度和 Hubble 尺度组合的限制，因此与 CMB 暴胀模型判别高度相关。
key_points: 研究轴子暴胀中 Abelian 规范场强反作用接近 Hubble 摩擦的区域。
用梯度展开和 one-loop in-in 计算评估微扰控制。
摘要给出一个由 CMB 非高斯性约束导出的 βH/M_p 上限。
methods: 轴子暴胀模型
赝标量相互作用 β φ F \tilde F /(4 M_p)
含轴子梯度的一阶梯度展开形式主义
one-loop in-in 计算
谱反作用评估
CMB 非高斯性约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对“温和反作用区域”的判据、梯度展开与 one-loop in-in 结果如何相互验证，以及 CMB 非高斯性上限 βH/M_p < 1.4×10^{-3} 的推导假设和适用范围。

papers.title: Response to: "Isotropic deceleration and near-zero baseline acceleration in Pantheon+ supernovae: new arguments in the dark energy debate''
papers.abstract: Ray et al. [1] have claimed that the acceleration of the Hubble expansion rate inferred from Type Ia supernovae in the Pantheon+ catalogue "is equally strong in the CMB dipole ($q_m = + 1.45$) and anti-dipole hemispheres ($+ 1.55$), directly contradicting the SRS26 anisotropy argument". Here SRS26 refers to our analysis [2] which showed that "locally $q_0$ has a strong dipole anisotropy aligned approximately with the bulk flow, and only a small monopole component remains at distances exceeding a few hundred Mpc". We find that these authors confused Equatorial with Galactic coordinates, thereby getting the CMB dipole direction wrong. Hence their conclusion is baseless.

analysis.title_zh: 回应：“Pantheon+ 超新星中的各向同性减速与近零基线加速：暗能量争论中的新论据”
analysis.summary_zh: 本文回应 Ray 等人关于 Pantheon+ 超新星中 Hubble 膨胀加速在 CMB 偶极和反偶极半球同样强的主张。摘要称，作者认为对方混淆赤道坐标和银道坐标，导致 CMB 偶极方向取错，因此其反驳 SRS26 各向异性论点的结论没有依据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Ia 型超新星对暗能量和晚期宇宙加速的证据与 CMB 定义的参考方向、偶极和大尺度运动密切相关。若 CMB 偶极方向或坐标系统使用错误，会直接影响对宇宙加速各向同性、局域 bulk flow 以及暗能量解释的讨论。
key_points: 这是一篇针对 Pantheon+ 超新星各向异性加速争议的回应。
作者称对方混淆了赤道坐标与银道坐标，从而误用 CMB 偶极方向。
摘要结论是对方关于反驳 SRS26 各向异性论点的说法没有依据。
methods: Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星目录相关分析的批评性回应
CMB 偶极方向
赤道坐标与银道坐标的坐标检查
与 SRS26 分析结论对照
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对坐标转换和 CMB 偶极方向使用是否确有错误，并检查双方对半球划分、q0 或 qm 定义、距离截断和 bulk flow 对齐的处理是否一致。

papers.title: Testing Scale-Dependent Suppression of Structure Growth in the Linear Regime
papers.abstract: We investigate recent reports of a suppression in the growth rate of cosmic structures inferred from analyses of the $[fσ_8](z)$ dataset. To address this issue, we explore the hypothesis that the evolution of matter clustering is more accurately described within the framework of scale-dependent modified gravity. We perform a joint analysis of $[fσ_8](z)$, cosmic chronometer $H(z)$ measurements, luminosity distance data, and CMB observations using Markov Chain Monte Carlo techniques to constrain the parameters of a scale-dependent cosmological model and investigate its impact on the evolution of $[fσ_8](z)$. Our results indicate that the suppression of the growth rate of large-scale structures is more pronounced during the matter-dominated era than in the dark-energy-dominated epoch. We find evidence for scale-dependent growth at a statistical significance of $2.2\, σ$. In addition, we constrain the $S_8$ parameter and find it to be consistent with the value inferred from the CMB observations of the Planck Collaboration. Overall, our analysis shows that $k$-dependent growth models provide a viable explanation for the observed clustering of matter without exacerbating the current cosmological tensions.

analysis.title_zh: 检验线性区间内结构增长的尺度依赖性抑制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对由 [fσ8](z) 数据分析得到的宇宙结构增长率受抑报告，检验尺度依赖修正引力是否能更好描述物质聚集演化。作者用 [fσ8](z)、宇宙 chronometer H(z)、光度距离和 CMB 观测做 MCMC 联合分析，摘要报告增长抑制在物质主导时期更明显，并给出尺度依赖增长的 2.2σ 证据，且 S8 与 Planck CMB 推断一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 结构增长率和 S8 是连接 CMB 初始条件与低红移大尺度结构观测的核心量；若增长具有 k 依赖性，会影响从 CMB 外推到晚期宇宙的 ΛCDM 一致性检验，也关系到 S8 张力和修正引力解释的可行性。
key_points: 联合使用增长率、几何距离和 CMB 数据检验尺度依赖增长模型。
摘要称物质主导时期的大尺度结构增长抑制更明显。
给出尺度依赖增长的 2.2σ 证据，并称 S8 与 Planck CMB 推断一致。
methods: [fσ8](z) 数据集
cosmic chronometer H(z) 测量
光度距离数据
CMB 观测
Markov Chain Monte Carlo 联合参数约束
尺度依赖修正引力宇宙学模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对尺度依赖模型的参数化、所用 CMB likelihood/数据组合、[fσ8](z) 数据的协方差处理，以及 2.2σ 证据是否对先验和数据选择稳健。

papers.title: Boosting the optical depth to Thomson scattering with primordial black hole evaporation at high redshift
papers.abstract: BAO and CMB data are somewhat discrepant when interpreted in the context of $Λ$cdm, discrepancies that show up as a `matter density deficit' and as a `CMB lensing excess'. One possible resolution is an increased optical depth to scattering off of free electrons in the post-recombination universe, $τ$, a possibility raised by Sailer et al. 2025 and Jhaveri et al. 2025. Since Planck measurements of the low-$\ell$ polarization `reionization bump' already constrain $τ$ from standard stellar-driven reionization at $z<10$, we investigate additional optical depth sourced by transient or partial reionization at higher redshift from exotic processes. For specificity, we explore the impact of Hawking radiation from a monochromatic spectrum of primordial black holes, retaining the high-$\ell$ $TT/TE/EE$ data that constrain such histories and varying the reionization redshift jointly. We find that the CMB data do not significantly prefer these additional signals: the boost is at most $Δτ\simeq 0.008$, well short of the $Δτ\simeq 0.03$ that would completely eliminate the moderate discrepancy. The matter density deficit and the lensing excess are not significantly eased: we explain why, tracing it to compensation from the reionization redshift and the residual PBH signal at $\ell > 30$.

analysis.title_zh: 利用高红移原初黑洞蒸发提高 Thomson 散射光学深度
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验高红移原初黑洞蒸发产生的额外电离能否提高 Thomson 散射光学深度 τ，从而缓解 BAO 与 CMB 在 ΛCDM 下的物质密度亏缺和 CMB 透镜过量问题。摘要报告 CMB 数据并不显著偏好这类额外信号，τ 的提升不足以消除中等张力，相关张力也未被明显缓解。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: τ 是 CMB 温度、偏振和透镜解释中的关键退化参数；若高红移额外电离可显著提高 τ，将影响 ΛCDM 参数、CMB lensing excess 和 BAO-CMB 一致性。该摘要的结果提示这一路径在 CMB 数据约束下难以充分解决相关张力。
key_points: 检验高红移原初黑洞蒸发是否能增加后复合时期自由电子散射光学深度。
同时保留高 ℓ TT/TE/EE 数据并联合改变再电离红移。
摘要称 CMB 数据并不显著偏好额外光学深度，且不能明显缓解物质密度亏缺和 CMB 透镜过量。

papers.title: Revisiting Metastable Dark Energy in Light of DESI DR2 BAO and DESI DR1 Full-Shape Measurements
papers.abstract: We revisit metastable dark energy (DE) models described by a radioactive-like decay law. We consider three scenarios: an effective, exponentially decaying DE component; decay of DE into non-baryonic dark matter (DM); and decay of DE into dark radiation (DR). We constrain the metastable DE models using DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) data, Type Ia supernovae (SNIa), cosmic microwave background (CMB) observations, and, for the first time, the current available DESI DR1 full-shape (FS) clustering measurements. The BAO+SNIa combinations show a mild preference for positive $Γ/H_0$, with a deviation from the $Λ$CDM limit at the $\gtrsim 2σ$ level. This corresponds to a decaying DE density and an effective quintessence-like behaviour at low redshift. Once CMB information from either Planck or P-ACT is included, however, the constraints become statistically consistent with $Γ/H_0=0$. The FS measurements probe the growth sector and help distinguish the interacting DM-DE behaviour of Model 2 from the effective decaying-DE response of Model 1 and the weaker DR-induced response of Model 3. For CMB+FS+DES-Dovekie, Model 1 shows a slight deviation from $Γ/H_0=0$ at the $\gtrsim 2σ$ level, while Models 2 and 3 remain consistent with the $Λ$CDM limit within $2σ$. Overall, metastable DE remains phenomenologically viable: current data allow late-time dynamics but do not provide decisive evidence for a nonzero decay rate. These results motivate extending our analysis to the upcoming DESI DR2 FS data to obtain tighter constraints on metastable dynamics.

analysis.title_zh: 结合 DESI DR2 BAO 与 DESI DR1 全形状测量重新审视亚稳态暗能量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新检验三类亚稳态暗能量模型，包括有效衰减暗能量、暗能量衰变为暗物质、以及衰变为暗辐射，并用 DESI DR2 BAO、SNIa、CMB 以及 DESI DR1 full-shape 成团数据进行约束。摘要报告称 BAO+SNIa 对非零衰变率有轻微偏好，但加入 CMB 后总体与 ΛCDM 极限一致，当前数据尚无决定性证据支持非零衰变率。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作关注晚期宇宙膨胀和结构增长是否偏离 ΛCDM，而 CMB 在其中提供早期宇宙锚点并显著改变衰变率约束。对 CMB 研究者而言，它说明 BAO、超新星、全形状成团与 CMB 联合分析中，暗能量动力学信号可能被早期宇宙约束削弱或重塑。
key_points: 研究三类具有放射性衰变形式的亚稳态暗能量模型。
BAO+SNIa 对正 Γ/H0 有轻微偏好，但加入 Planck 或 P-ACT CMB 后与 Γ/H0=0 统计一致。
DESI DR1 full-shape 数据用于生长结构信息，帮助区分不同衰变或相互作用情形。

papers.title: Effects of the inflaton mass on the pre-inflationary dynamics and primordial power spectra in loop quantum cosmology
papers.abstract: Considering the mass parameters as free phenomenological parameters, we investigate inflation driven by a canonical scalar field with different potentials in LQC. We find that a smaller mass value makes it easier to obtain a sufficient number of e-folds for the quadratic potential, while for the Starobinsky potential, more e-folds are obtained for larger mass values. By estimating the probability of slow-roll inflation, we find that it remains very close to unity for all considered cases. We compute the primordial power spectrum using three approaches: the dressed metric, the hybrid, and the alternative mass function approaches for the case that the kinetic energy dominated at bounce. The resulting power spectrum for both potentials and different mass values shows the same qualitative pattern in all three approaches. It is suppressed at small $k$, amplified and oscillating over an intermediate range, and nearly scale-invariant at large $k$. The approaches mainly differ in how fast the power spectrum converges to this regime, with the hybrid approach converging the fastest, followed by the alternative mass function and dressed metric approaches. We find that the pivot scale $k_\star$ is highly sensitive to the inflaton mass, changing by more than an order of magnitude for a mass variation of only a few percent. Using the tensor power spectrum at $k_\star$, we calculate the scalar spectral index $n_s$ and tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$, finding good agreement with current data. Finally, the scalar power spectra are fed into the CAMB code to obtain the angular power spectrum and compare with the Planck 2018 data and the best-fit $Λ$CDM model. All three approaches are consistent with data at high multipoles, while at low multipoles the hybrid approach gives the closest agreement and the dressed metric approach shows the largest deviation.

analysis.title_zh: 环量子宇宙学中 inflaton 质量对暴胀前动力学和原初功率谱的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文把 inflaton 质量作为自由现象学参数，研究环量子宇宙学中二次势和 Starobinsky 势的暴胀前动力学、慢滚概率和原初功率谱。摘要报告称，三种扰动处理方法得到相似的谱形态：小 k 抑制、中间尺度放大并振荡、大 k 近尺度不变；经 CAMB 与 Planck 2018 比较后，高多极均与数据一致，低多极处 hybrid 方法最接近。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接连接 LQC 反弹物理、原初标量/张量扰动和 CMB 角功率谱，尤其关注低多极异常可能对暴胀前历史和量子引力修正的敏感性。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键价值在于它把不同 LQC 扰动方案的原初谱差异传递到 Planck 可观测量中进行比较。

比较 dressed metric、hybrid 与 alternative mass function 三种方法。
摘要称低多极处 hybrid 方法与 Planck 2018 更接近，dressed metric 偏离最大。

papers.title: Do we really need alternatives to the $ω_0ω_a$CDM parameterization after the DESI DR2?
papers.abstract: We introduce a density-level pivot construction for the Chevallier-Polarski-Linder (CPL) parameterization by defining the normalized dark energy density $f_p\equiv f_{\rm DE}(a_p)$ and the equation of state $ω_p\equiv ω(a_p)$ at an optimized pivot scale factor $a_p$. This reparameterization leaves the underlying CPL cosmology unchanged and allows the two models to be compared using parameters with a direct physical interpretation at the epoch where the data are most sensitive. Accordingly, following the DESI DR2 results, we compare a newly proposed $f_a f_b$CDM parameterization, based on a second-order Taylor expansion of the normalized dark energy density, with the standard $w_0w_a$CDM model. In particular, we constrain the original and pivoted parameterizations using compressed cosmic microwave background (CMB), DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO), cosmic chronometers (CC), and Pantheon+ Type Ia supernovae data, with the SH0ES prior imposed on $H_0$. We find that applying the same density-level pivot prescription to the $w_0w_a$CDM model substantially reduces the correlation between its dark energy parameters and provides tighter and more stable constraints. The statistical comparison shows that this model remains favored over the Taylor expansion of the dark energy density, even when both models are analyzed in the optimized parameter basis. Moreover, the pivoted CPL parameterization accurately reproduces the background evolution of quintessence models, providing a reliable phenomenological approximation to the underlying dark energy dynamics, better than the $f_af_b$CDM model. We conclude that changing the parameter basis improves the performance of the $w_0w_a$CDM model, which emerges as the most suitable framework to describe the dark energy sector within the class of models considered here.

analysis.title_zh: DESI DR2 之后，我们真的需要替代 ω0ωaCDM 参数化吗？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 DESI DR2 后是否需要替代标准 w0waCDM 参数化的问题，提出 CPL 模型的密度层面 pivot 重参数化，并与基于暗能量密度二阶 Taylor 展开的 f_a f_b CDM 比较。摘要称，pivot 后的 CPL 降低了暗能量参数相关性、约束更稳定，并在统计比较和对 quintessence 背景演化的复现方面优于 f_a f_b CDM。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量参数化会影响 CMB 距离先验与低红移 BAO、超新星、H0 数据的联合解释，进而影响对 ΛCDM 张力和动态暗能量迹象的判断。该文使用压缩 CMB 与 DESI DR2 等数据比较参数基选择，对 CMB 约束如何进入暗能量模型选择具有直接相关性。

使用压缩 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO、CC、Pantheon+ 与 SH0ES 先验约束模型。

papers.title: From Quantum Correlations to Inflationary Tracking Scalar Field Evolution
papers.abstract: The tracking condition $\dotφ^2=γH^{-m}$ for single scalar field theory leads to analytic inflationary solutions, which are compatible with the current cosmic microwave background radiation experiments. To our knowledge this is the only analytic solution of inflation which is compatible with the data, to date. In this work we seek for some theoretical basis that can lead to the tracking condition $\dotφ^2=γH^{-m}$. As we show, if the Universe is seen pre-inflationary as a quantum statistical system, the scalar field may emerge as a collective condensate of the quantum degrees of freedom. In the quantum-to-classical transition of the Universe, the scalar field two point function yields the susceptibility of the theory with an inherent correlation length. Using information theoretic motivation and Wilsonian quantum field theoretic arguments, we demonstrate that the tracking conditions $\dotφ^2=γH^{-m}$ emerge from this framework.

analysis.title_zh: 从量子关联到暴胀 tracking 标量场演化
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论单标量场暴胀中 tracking 条件 dotφ^2=γH^{-m} 的理论来源，认为暴胀前宇宙可视作量子统计系统，标量场可作为量子自由度的集体凝聚出现。摘要称，通过量子到经典转变中的二点函数、信息论动机和 Wilsonian 场论论证，可以得到该 tracking 条件。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作关注暴胀动力学条件的微观或统计起源，而暴胀模型的可行性最终需通过 CMB 标量谱、张量谱等观测量检验。它对 CMB 读者的意义主要在于提供一种可能生成与观测相容解析暴胀解的理论框架，但摘要未给出新的 CMB 数据分析。
key_points: 尝试为单标量场 tracking 条件提供量子统计和场论动机。
tracking 条件可导出解析暴胀解，摘要称其与当前 CMB 实验相容。

papers.title: New constraints on modified gravity with dimension-six operators from gravitational waves
papers.abstract: The present article deals with gravitational-wave propagation affected by higher-derivative terms that break spacetime symmetries. Two dimension-6 contributions of the gravitational Standard-Model Extension pose our starting point. A linearization of the action implies a wave equation that contains additional terms with spacetime-constant background fields. The modified dispersion relations in covariant form for gravitational waves are derived, where we distinguish between nonbirefringent and birefringent sectors. A classification of the coefficients in terms of sets with index structures resembling those of the electromagnetic fields has proven to be valuable. We constrain the nonbirefringent coefficients based on the measured arrival time difference between the gravitational wave and photons from the events GW170817 and GRB 170817A, respectively. Bounds on the birefringent coefficients result from the absence of a perceivable separation of the two modes in the event GW150914. These findings quantify the extent to which standard linearized gravity is valid based on the modifications considered.

analysis.title_zh: 利用引力波对含维数六算符的修正引力给出新约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究破坏时空对称性的高阶导数项如何修正引力波传播，从引力标准模型扩展的两个维数六贡献出发，线性化作用量并推导非双折射与双折射扇区的协变修正色散关系。摘要称，作者利用GW170817与GRB 170817A的引力波-光子到达时间差约束非双折射系数，并用GW150914中未见两种模式可感知分离来约束双折射系数。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接处理CMB数据，但属于宇宙学基础物理和引力理论检验：引力波传播中的洛伦兹/时空对称性破缺会影响对标准线性化引力的信任范围，也与CMB对引力、早期宇宙和基本对称性的间接约束形成互补。
key_points: 研究引力标准模型扩展中维数六高阶导数项对引力波传播的影响。

papers.title: Measurement of the Hubble constant with high-energy neutrinos
papers.abstract: Measuring distances in the Universe is one of the hardest problems in physics and astronomy. Almost every distance probe relies on photons, whose propagation across cosmic distances introduces extinction, absorption, scattering, and radiative-transfer effects. Neutrinos suffer none of these and propagate unattenuated through dust, intergalactic medium, and dense source environments alike. We introduce a new distance-ladder method for measuring the Hubble constant $H_0$ using high-energy astrophysical neutrinos from point sources as standardizable candles, and report its first observational realization. Using 12 X-ray-selected Seyfert galaxies for which IceCube reports significant per-source neutrino excesses in its 14-year public point-source release, we exploit the disk-corona correlation $L_ν= κ\, L_X^β$ between neutrino and X-ray luminosities to construct a neutrino distance ladder anchored by non-redshift distances to NGC 1068 (Cepheid + TRGB). We find $H_0 = 49^{+40}_{-30}\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $β= 0.67^{+0.16}_{-0.25}$ (68% credible intervals), with the corona slope disfavoring the calorimetric limit $β= 1$ at ${\sim}2σ$. The result is consistent with existing $H_0$ determinations from Planck and SH0ES within 1$σ$. While the uncertainty on $H_0$ is large, the measurement is free of electromagnetic propagation systematics and demonstrates the viability of neutrinos as a novel cosmographical probe.

analysis.title_zh: 用高能中微子测量哈勃常数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一种用高能天体物理中微子点源作为可标准化烛光的H0距离阶梯方法，以12个IceCube报告有显著逐源中微子超额的X射线选取Seyfert星系为样本，并用NGC 1068的Cepheid+TRGB非红移距离锚定中微子-X射线光度关系。摘要报告得到H0 = 49^{+40}_{-30} km s^{-1} Mpc^{-1}，不确定度很大，但与Planck和SH0ES的H0测定在1σ内一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0是CMB宇宙学的核心派生参数，也是Planck与局域距离阶梯张力的焦点；若中微子距离阶梯可行，它将提供一种几乎不受电磁传播消光、吸收和散射影响的独立宇宙学距离探针，可与CMB和传统光子距离指标交叉检验。

papers.title: Nelson-Barr Inflation
papers.abstract: The Nelson-Barr mechanism solves the strong CP problem through spontaneous CP violation, but the resulting CP-conjugate vacua generically lead to stable domain walls. We propose that the Nelson-Barr scalar itself drives hilltop inflation. A CP-symmetric double-well potential for its imaginary component forms two CP-breaking valleys, with inflation proceeding along one of them. Since the lowest CP-invariant ridge is generically much higher than the energy available after inflation, transitions between the two branches are energetically inaccessible, and the domain walls cannot be regenerated after inflation. A small CP-preserving linear deformation raises the scalar spectral index of quartic hilltop inflation and yields CMB-compatible parameter regions. The Nelson-Barr sector necessarily provides a portal to visible-sector reheating. When coupled to right-handed neutrinos, it can also transmit the spontaneous CP phase to the lepton sector and, in an extension that allows a higher CP-breaking scale, even realize nonthermal leptogenesis. This establishes a unified cosmological realization of the Nelson--Barr mechanism in which the same CP-breaking dynamics solves the strong CP problem, can generate quark and lepton CP violation, drives inflation and reheating, and enables baryogenesis, while simultaneously eliminating the associated domain-wall problem.

analysis.title_zh: Nelson-Barr暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出由Nelson-Barr标量本身驱动hilltop暴胀，使同一套自发CP破缺动力学同时处理强CP问题、畴壁问题、再加热以及可能的轻子/重子生成。摘要称，一个小的CP守恒线性形变可提高四次hilltop暴胀的标量谱指数，并产生与CMB相容的参数区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接涉及暴胀模型与CMB可观测量，尤其是标量谱指数等对早期宇宙势能形状的约束；它也把粒子物理中的CP破缺、畴壁和重子生成问题与CMB检验的暴胀动力学联系起来。

机制旨在避免Nelson-Barr模型通常伴随的稳定畴壁再生问题。
小的CP守恒线性形变可改善四次hilltop暴胀的标量谱指数并给出CMB兼容参数区。
